name: European ST-T Database: Myocardial Ischemia Detection Benchmark
description: The European ST-T Database is a standard international reference library created by the CNR Institute of Clinical Physiology in Pisa, Italy, and the Thoraxcenter in Rotterdam under the auspices of the European Society of Cardiology. It comprises 90 two-hour continuous two-channel ambulatory ECG recordings from 79 subjects (70 men and 9 women, aged 30 to 84) with diagnosed or suspected myocardial ischemia. Each record is sampled at 250 Hz with 12-bit resolution and annotated with beat-by-beat labels as well as detailed episodic markers for ischemic and non-ischemic ST-segment and T-wave morphology variations.
